title: Reviewing a session
viewerNote: The sample rubric ratings and earlier notes are authored. The phone take anchors one note to a selection and uses whole-turn notes for the other two. The pass menu opens without running a model pass.

chapters.title: Select a passage
chapters.explanation: Select the part of the reply you want to mark.

chapters.title: Record a strength
chapters.explanation: Use Turn list to open turn 6, then choose Add note to annotate that turn.

chapters.title: Record a suggestion
chapters.explanation: Use Turn list to open turn 8, then choose Add note to annotate that turn.

chapters.title: Inspect a rubric score
chapters.explanation: Read the rubric alongside the transcript.

chapters.title: Inspect the pass menu
chapters.explanation: See what a Socratic pass can propose.

chapters.title: Inspect the export sheet
chapters.explanation: Check what goes into the review export.
